notes_for_review: 1) There is no twilight exterior in this shoot, so the lead is the daytime front (0) and nothing says "virtual twilight" except the general service mention in the Google post's booking line. 2) Photo 1 (top-down drone) has a thin straight line running left from the house. It looks like a real chain-link fence and its shadow, not a drawn-on line, but please confirm at full size. 3) In photo 11 (bay aerial) the house can't be picked out, so it is captioned as a neighborhood and bay view. 4) The date of April 2025 matches the 20250409 drone file names, but I didn't check it against the EXIF. 5) I left out photo 28 (the back room with tile floor and a door to the yard) because I couldn't tell whether it is a sunroom, mudroom or bedroom.
left_out: 4 and 15 are duplicates of the lead front exterior (0). 2 and 3 are alternate front angles. 8, 9, 10, 12, 13 and 14 are drone shots with red arrow markers. 5, 6, 7, 16, 17 and 18 repeat the side and rear angles. 23 is the driveway view. 26, 31, 32, 38, 39, 42 and 43 are near-duplicate kitchen views. 40 is a second living room angle. 27, 34, 35, 36 and 37 repeat the bedrooms. 28 is a back room with a door to the yard; I couldn't tell what kind of room it is. 29 is the laundry and 30 is the unfinished garage. 45 and 46 are other angles of the same bathroom. 21 repeats the outdoor shower.

facebook.text:
We photographed 110 W Wilde Ave in Villas for Jason Ruffenach of eXp Realty. This yellow ranch has a crisp white kitchen with an aqua hexagon backsplash, built-in shelving in the living area and a bathroom finished in brass and light wood. Out back there's a cedar outdoor shower, and the drone showed the whole lot plus the view out to the bay.

New shoot: 110 W Wilde Ave, Villas NJ

We photographed this yellow stucco ranch for Jason Ruffenach of eXp Realty. The gallery covers the front exterior with its one-car garage and wide concrete driveway, a white shaker kitchen with an aqua hexagon tile backsplash and stainless appliances, and a living area with built-in shelving and wood floors. We also shot a bedroom and a bathroom with a fluted wood vanity, brass fixtures and a backlit mirror.

Out back, we photographed the patio, the fenced yard and a new cedar outdoor shower. The drone captured a top-down view of the full lot and an aerial looking over Villas to the Delaware Bay.
